fields.short_description: Understand the ecosystem before you begin.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Vitanaland is your new digital world for health and personal growth. It's the platform where I, your assistant Vitana, live.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Here you have your safe space to work on your goals at your own pace. You're never alone, because your MAXINA community is also at home here.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You come to Vitanaland whenever you need support in daily life or want to connect with others.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap Continue now to see how you can reach me anytime through the ORB.

fields.short_description: Understand the ecosystem before you begin.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The MAXINA community is your personal network within Vitanaland. Here, people come together who want to grow together.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You're never alone on your journey and benefit from others' experiences. This gives you a sense of belonging and fresh motivation every day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You visit this area when you want to connect with others, join events, or simply gather some inspiration.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the community overview now and take a look around.

fields.short_description: Get to know the assistant and voice control.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: I'm Vitana, your personal assistant. You can reach me through the ORB, the small sphere in the bottom right corner of your screen.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: With me, you hardly have to type anything anymore. Just talk to me, and I'll remember everything important for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: If you want to quickly log a glass of water you just drank, for example, just tell me.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the ORB now and see how easy it is.

fields.short_description: Get to know the assistant and voice control.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The ORB is the small sphere in the bottom right corner of your screen. When you tap it, you can talk to me right away.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You skip the hassle of typing. Just tell me what you need, and I'll log it for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Tap the ORB when you want to quickly log your first glass of water after waking up, without typing.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the ORB now and just say a quick hello to me.

fields.short_description: 90 sessions, free navigation, and exercises explained simply.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: "My Journey" is your guided path through Vitanaland, divided into 90 short lessons. You can jump between topics, but you'll always practice what you've learned in real life first to truly master it.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't need a perfect plan to live healthier. These small, daily steps help you build new habits in a relaxed way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check "My Journey" every morning to find your next lesson or task for the day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to jump right into your journey and look around.

fields.short_description: 90 sessions, free navigation, and exercises explained simply.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: My Journey consists of 90 short stops that show you Vitanaland. You can simply jump to new topics or unlock stops directly by trying them out.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This gives you complete freedom to learn at your own pace. You only focus on what actually helps you in everyday life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Open the overview whenever you're curious about the next step.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap My Journey and discover your upcoming stops.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Life Compass is your most important goal for the next 90 days. It sets the direction I'll guide you toward.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This lets me tailor every suggestion precisely to your personal wish. You'll only receive tips that truly bring you closer to your big goal.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Choose a goal in the Life Compass when you want to focus entirely on something like your health or your career.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and open the Life Compass to take a closer look.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Life Compass is your most important goal for the next 90 days. It gives me the exact direction we want to go together.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This lets me tailor every tip to your current wishes. Each small step then helps you achieve exactly that dream.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You set it whenever you want to focus on a new area in your life, like your health or your career.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and choose the first direction for your Life Compass.

fields.short_description: Get to know the Vitana Index early on.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your Vitana Index grows with every healthy choice you make in daily life. Whether you drink a glass of water or go for a walk, the number adjusts right away.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you can see directly which small habits benefit you the most. It shows you in black and white what really does your body good.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your Index to see how even a short walk or a glass of water improves your number.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open your Vitana Index now and discover which small action can boost it right away.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your health in Vitanaland always rests on five pillars: sleep, movement, nutrition, mental strength, and hydration. Together, they form your Vitana Index.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This makes the goal of living healthier wonderfully simple and measurable for you. At a glance, you can see where you're already strong and where you can still balance things out.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this overview daily to check whether your different areas of life are well balanced.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap now to take a closer look at your five pillars on the next screen.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your weakest pillar is the area among the five pillars that currently needs the most attention. I identify this automatically for you every day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way, you don't have to make everything perfect at once. When you strengthen this one area specifically, your Vitana Index rises the fastest.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your weakest pillar in the morning to set your focus for the day in a relaxed way.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to find out which of your pillars is your weakest today.

fields.short_description: The promise of greater quality of life.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Life Compass is your most important goal for the next ninety days. It helps me guide your quality of life in exactly the right direction.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: From now on, all my tips adapt to this one wish. This way, we're not just collecting data—we're noticeably improving your life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You use the compass whenever you want to shift your focus in life toward something new for a while.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to discover your own Life Compass and choose your first goal.

fields.short_description: The promise of greater quality of life.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Life Compass is your most important goal for the next 90 days. When you put your health at the center here, everything aligns around it.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You won't get random tips—you'll receive tailored suggestions for more sleep and movement. This way, every small step brings you noticeably closer to a healthy life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You choose this focus when you want to give your body your full attention again after a demanding time.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and align your Life Compass toward health.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The privacy section gives you full control over your personal information in Vitanaland. Here, you alone decide which data stays private and which can be shared.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This gives you complete peace of mind, because nothing ever happens without your explicit permission. You can use Vitana totally relaxed and worry-free.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check this section when you want to specify exactly which information Autopilot can use to find suitable offers for you.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the privacy settings now and see how easily you can control everything.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: So I can support you properly, I save important details in your memories. But you always decide entirely on your own what I'm allowed to remember.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This gives me the ability to make truly fitting suggestions for My Journey in your daily life. At the same time, you always keep absolute control over your data.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You use this feature whenever I should add a new detail about you to the memory garden.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to try out for yourself how you give me permission to remember.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your profile is your personal home in the MAXINA community. Here you simply show who you are and what interests you.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: A completed profile helps me find the perfect people and opportunities for you. It makes you visible so others can support you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Fill out your profile before you ask me to search for matching contacts or new opportunities for you.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on your profile and add your first interest right away.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your profile is your calling card in the MAXINA community. It shows others who you are and what you're good at.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: A well-filled profile instantly builds trust with others. It helps you find the right people and great new opportunities.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You maintain your profile whenever you want to make new connections or become more visible in the community.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on your profile now and add a new piece of information to build trust in the community.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The ORB is the small round sphere in the bottom right corner of your screen. When you tap it, I listen to you and answer your questions.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't have to type anything laboriously anymore—you can simply talk to me naturally. This saves you time and makes your daily life easier.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use the ORB, for example, when you're on the go and want to quickly add something to your journal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the ORB and ask me your first question right now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: With the ORB, you can easily navigate through Vitanaland using your voice. Just tell me where you want to go, and I'll open the right page for you.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't have to memorize menus or search for a long time. This saves you time and makes everything super easy to use.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this when you want to quickly open your journal or your Life Compass without searching on the screen.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the ORB right now and tell me to open the Life Compass to try it out.

fields.short_description: This is what your daily start looks like.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The daily rhythm is your simple routine here in Vitanaland. It consists of small, doable steps that connect your health with concrete actions for the day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't need a perfect plan to live healthier. This simple routine helps you take care of yourself every day without any stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this routine in the morning with your coffee to start your day, and in the evening to briefly capture your experiences in your journal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to try out your first daily rhythm.

fields.short_description: This is what your daily start looks like.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: During the first 30 days, I'll guide you with small, daily tips on your home screen. It's like a guided tour through the app.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way, you'll discover a new, useful feature every day without feeling overwhelmed. The discovery tour adapts at a relaxed pace to your own rhythm.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Simply check your home screen every morning to discover your short tip for the day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button to jump right into your first little exercise and try it out for yourself.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Sleep is one of the five pillars in Vitana and forms the foundation of your recovery. It's a key building block for keeping your Vitana Index in balance.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: A good overview of your sleep shows you whether you're truly getting enough rest. This way you can make small adjustments to start your day with much more energy.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You check this area when you wake up in the morning and want to understand why you're full of energy or still feeling tired.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the sleep area now to take a closer look at this important pillar.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Sleep is one of the five pillars and the most important time for your recovery. Here you enter how long and how well you slept during the night.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: When you track your sleep, you understand exactly how your night's rest affects your day. This helps you plan your energy better.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to log your sleep in your journal every morning right after waking up.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the screen now and enter last night's sleep to try it out.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Hydration is one of the five pillars for your health. It simply shows you whether your body is getting enough water each day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Drinking enough water instantly gives you more energy and helps you stay more alert. It's the easiest way to support your body and your Vitana Index.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check this pillar when you feel tired in the afternoon and need a quick energy boost.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap continue to explore your hydration area now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you enter how much water you've had. It's a simple way to keep track of your hydration.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you can see right away whether your body has enough water. It's a quick win for your daily routine.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it right after getting up, for example, when you drink your first glass of water.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button and log your first water now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Movement is one of the five pillars in your life compass. It shows you how active you are each day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Regular activity is like an engine that gives you fresh energy. It helps you feel more alert and stronger in your daily life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Think of this pillar when you take a refreshing walk after sitting at your desk for a long time.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the movement area now and see where you can find your activities.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is where you log how you moved today. It could be a walk, a workout, or even some housework.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you quickly see how movement gives you fresh energy. Every step counts and strengthens your well-being.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this feature right after a short walk or at the end of the day when you're relaxed.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button and log your first movement now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Nutrition is one of the five pillars for your health. Here you easily keep track of what you eat.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you see how your meals affect your Vitana Index. It helps you understand your body better without any stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your nutrition pillar when you want to know if you've eaten well and balanced today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and open your nutrition pillar.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: A meal note is a simple way to record your food in your journal. You don't need to count calories—just briefly describe your dish.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you keep track of your nutrition in a relaxed way, without stressing yourself out. It's a simple way to keep an eye on one of the most important of the five pillars.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to make a quick note right after lunch, while the memory is still fresh.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and create your very first meal note.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Mental strength is one of the five pillars of your wellbeing. It includes everything that's good for your mind, like relaxation, focus, or beautiful moments.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This helps you see how well you're taking care of your inner balance. You'll notice right away when you should take more time for yourself.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check this area when your daily life is particularly stressful and you're looking for ways to find inner calm.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to take a closer look at your mental strength area.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The one-minute reset is a short, guided break for your mind. It's a very simple exercise for your mental strength.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: It helps you quickly release everyday stress and refocus. This gives you an instant boost of fresh energy.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it when everything feels a bit too much or when you just want to take a quick breath between appointments.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button for the one-minute reset and try this soothing relaxation right now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The journal is your place for quick notes throughout the day. Here you can record anything that matters for your health and the five pillars.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: It makes your progress visible and helps you live more mindfully. The more you share, the better I learn how to support you in just the right way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it in the evening to reflect on your day, or in between to note a glass of water or how you're feeling.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the journal now and write your first short entry for today.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The voice journal is the easiest way to capture your experiences. You simply tap the microphone and speak, instead of typing everything out.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This saves you a lot of time and feels completely natural. I understand your words right away and automatically use them for your Vitana Index.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it right after a workout or during a short break to quickly tell me what you've just been doing.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the little microphone now and record your very first entry.

fields.short_description: Stay on track and follow through.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Reminders are little nudges in your daily life. They help you not forget the tasks you've planned.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you don't have to remember everything yourself and stay relaxed on course. It frees up your mind and helps you stick with it.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use them when you want to drink a glass of water every afternoon or jot something in your journal in the evening, for example.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to open and explore the reminders area.

fields.short_description: Stay on track and follow through.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: With a reminder, you set things up so I remind you of your plans in time. That way nothing gets lost in your daily life.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This makes it much easier for you to stick with your good intentions. Your mind is free because I take care of the remembering for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Create a reminder when you plan to drink a glass of water tonight but worry you might forget in the hustle and bustle.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and set your very first reminder.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The calendar is your personal time planner in Vitanaland. This is where your healthy intentions get a fixed spot.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Good intentions become habits more easily when they have a set time. This way you put your plans into action in a relaxed and reliable way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Add an appointment when you're thinking in the morning about when you'll have time for a walk today, for example.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the calendar now and reserve some time right away for your first healthy intention.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is a small window that opens right over your current screen. Here you turn a good intention into a planned action.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't lose your train of thought because you don't have to leave your current screen. This way you put your goals into action right away, without detours.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it when you want to schedule something important for later in the day without interrupting your current task.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and plan a small, quick action for today.

fields.short_description: You choose how deep you go.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Autopilot is your personal guide that suggests fitting tasks for you every day. It waits as a small airplane icon for your decisions.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You decide entirely on your own which paths you take and how deep you want to dive. This way, you only commit to what truly feels right for you today.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it in the morning to calmly choose the best steps for your day and find your own pace.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the airplane icon now and discover your first paths for today.

fields.short_description: You choose how deep you go.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Autopilot is your personal, intelligent task list that you access through the airplane icon. It suggests concrete steps, but you choose what you actually want to do.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This takes daily planning off your hands and shows you exactly what will strengthen your Vitana Index the most today. You always stay in full control, because nothing happens without your okay.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Best use it first thing in the morning to pick the right actions for your day and hit go.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the small airplane icon now to see your first suggestions and start your day.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your daily rhythm is a simple flow of discovering, acting, and logging in your journal. This way, you build a healthy routine step by step.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't need a perfect plan to live healthier. This small cycle helps you see doable progress every day without stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Start this simple flow every morning to head into your day relaxed and with a clear goal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to open your overview for today and try out the flow.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Autopilot is your intelligent companion for the day. It automatically suggests the next small task that fits you right now.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't have to come up with a perfect health plan. I take that work off your hands and simply show you the best next step.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use Autopilot whenever you have a small break and want to do something good for your health.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap Autopilot and see which action I've prepared for you today.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is where you decide how to handle your daily tasks. You can complete them right away or simply postpone them.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This takes the pressure off having to do everything perfectly every day. I learn which rhythm works best for you along the way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this feature when you're planning your day and deciding what's actually doable right now.
fields.explanation_try_this: Now pick a task and decide whether you want to complete it or postpone it.

fields.short_description: Home is your daily command center.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The home screen is your daily command center in the app. Right after logging in, you'll see all the important updates and shortcuts here.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: It saves you valuable time because the most important information is visible right away. At a glance, you can see what's a priority today and how your Vitana Index is doing.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Open the home screen every morning like a good newspaper to quickly check in on your day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap through your home screen now and see what's new today.

fields.short_description: Home is your daily command center.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The home screen is your command center for every day. Here you'll find all your important tasks, reminders, and recommendations at a glance.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You save time and see right away what's coming up next. This helps you work toward your goals without a lot of effort or stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to check your home screen first thing every morning to plan your day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and explore your personal home screen.

fields.short_description: Home is your daily command center.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The AI feed is a special section on your home screen. Here you'll find personal insights generated specifically for you.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Instead of generic news, you get tips here that match your life compass exactly. So you know right away which small change will benefit you most today.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your AI feed in the morning with your first coffee to find your personal focus for the day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the AI feed now and rate your first post so I can get to know you even better.

fields.short_description: This is how your index becomes actionable.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Index drivers are the concrete everyday actions that change your Vitana Index. These include things like a glass of water, a walk, or a good night's sleep.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: They show you exactly which small changes truly benefit your body. This way, you learn which simple steps boost your wellbeing the most.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use them whenever you're thinking about which small action would make the biggest positive difference for you today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and discover which actions move your Vitana Index the most.

fields.short_description: This is how your index becomes actionable.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Vitana Index is made up of scores for your five pillars: sleep, movement, nutrition, mental strength, and hydration. These individual scores show you exactly how your overall score comes together.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: At a glance, you can see where you're already on track and which area still needs some attention. This makes it really easy to make the right choice for your day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your scores in the morning, for example, to see whether you should focus more on your water intake or on getting more movement today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the detail view now to explore the individual scores of your five pillars.

fields.short_description: This is how your index becomes actionable.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Each day, you can deliberately choose one action that will improve your Vitana Index the most. This action becomes your personal driver.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Instead of trying to change everything at once, you focus on a single, impactful task. This saves energy and moves you forward right away.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to do this right after waking up, so you can set a clear goal for your day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and choose your very first driver for today.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The sleep trend shows you clearly and simply how your recovery develops over time. It belongs to the sleep area, one of the five pillars of your health.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll immediately spot patterns in your nights and see whether you might be missing important rest. This helps you tremendously in keeping your Vitana Index balanced.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Take a quick look in the morning to better understand why you feel more energized or more tired than usual today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and discover your own sleep trend.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your sleep plan is your personal roadmap to a restful night. It's part of the Sleep pillar and helps you wind down better in the evening.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll wake up with more energy and feel noticeably fresher. This is how you strengthen your Vitana Index in a targeted way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Take a quick look at it in the evening before you get ready for bed.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to discover your own sleep plan.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your bedtime reminder is a gentle nudge in the evening. It helps you wind down in time.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you'll never miss the perfect moment to go to sleep. Your body can recover better and you'll start the new day feeling fresher.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: This reminder is ideal in the evening when you want to wrap up your day in a relaxed way and prepare for a restful night.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to set up and try your first bedtime reminder.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Hydration pillar shows you how well you're drinking throughout the day. You can easily log your drinks in your journal or connect a tracker.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you can see right away if your body is getting enough water to stay fit. It helps you keep your Vitana Index in balance.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Log your drinks right after waking up or with every meal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen and log your first glass of water right now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your nutrition is one of the five pillars that make up your Vitana Index. This is where all the data from your connected trackers and your journal comes together.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you can easily see if your body is getting the right energy for the day. It helps you make healthier choices without a lot of effort.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Take a quick look at this pillar in the evening when you want to check how balanced your day was.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the nutrition pillar now to connect your daily trackers.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: In the diary, you can log your daily movement or connect your fitness trackers directly. This way, you collect all your activities in one secure place.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: When I know how you move, I can give you tips that fit your everyday life better. This strengthens you and improves your personal Vitana Index.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this feature right after a walk or in the evening to capture your daily activities.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the diary now and add today's movement.

fields.short_description: Connect inner calm with good decisions.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The pattern for mental well-being shows you how your inner calm affects your everyday life. It's a valuable part of your mental pillar.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll clearly see how a relaxed mind helps you make healthier decisions. This gives you more control over your well-being.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Look at this pattern when you've had a restless day and want to understand what's disrupting your balance.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen and discover your own mental patterns now.

fields.short_description: Connect inner calm with good decisions.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is where you record your breathing exercises or meditations. It's a simple place for your moments of calm.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: When you're relaxed inside, you make much clearer decisions. This builds your mental strength day by day.

fields.vitana_voice_script:
Hello, I'm Vitana, your AI assistant. Welcome to the MAXINA Community! Here we start your longevity journey together toward better health, more energy, and more joy in life.

The MAXINA Community was created by professional dancer Mariia Maksina. Mariia radiates pure joy for life through her lifestyle and wants to share that joy every day with friends, acquaintances, and like-minded people.

Especially when it comes to health, it matters who we share our daily lives with and who we trust. Here you'll meet like-minded people who, just like you, are working on their health with greater awareness and supporting each other in the community.

Our formula is based on five pillars that should be in balance: nutrition, hydration, movement, sleep, and mental health. These five areas will accompany you throughout your entire journey.

Together we'll create your Longevity Compass, also called Life Compass. It's your personal north star on your longevity journey. It shows you what matters to you, which direction fits your life, and which goals truly motivate you.

And so you can see your progress grow every day and recognize how your journey is developing, the Vitana Index helps you track this. With every entry in your journal, your Daily Diary, you increase your index score and give me, Vitana, the ability to give you better recommendations or reminders.

Then we'll fill in important basics in your profile. This way I, Vitana, can understand you better, support you better, and give you more fitting recommendations.

The heart of Vitanaland is the ORB. When you tap the ORB, I'm there for you. You can ask me anything: for support, advice, recommendations, motivation, information, or your next best step.

In the MAXINA Community, you can participate, learn, and get inspired. But you can also do your own thing: build a new source of income in the longevity space, develop a new foundation, maybe step by step free yourself from your old job and build something completely new.

You can build your own network of friends and customers and share your skills with other people. Every person is different, and that's exactly why everyone finds their own path here.

As they say: The journey is the destination. Enjoy your journey every day. See your results. Feel your improvement. Celebrate your success. Your longevity journey starts now.

Now let's talk about your plan. Your plan is like a friendly map for your journey. It shows you what fits you, what's coming next, and how to keep moving forward step by step.

Together we'll define your Life Compass. It will be your north star on your longevity journey. It helps you see your direction: for your health, your energy, your friendships, your goals, your business, and new possibilities in your life.

Your plan builds on the five pillars: nutrition, hydration, movement, sleep, and mental health. These areas help you shape your daily life more consciously and strengthen your balance step by step.

And so you can see your progress grow every day and recognize how your journey is developing, the Vitana Index helps you track this. With every entry in your journal, your Daily Diary, you increase your index score and give me, Vitana, the ability to give you better recommendations or reminders.

Your plan connects your personal goals with the key features: your profile, your Daily Diary, your Autopilot, your sessions, and your ORB. Everything works together so your journey stays clear, simple, and motivating.

Your plan can also become a business plan for your future. Maybe you want to build a new source of income in the longevity space, develop a new foundation, or step by step free yourself from your old job and build something completely new.

In the MAXINA Community, you can build your own network of friends and customers and share your skills with other people.

Tap the ORB anytime. I, Vitana, am here to explain your plan, give you ideas, make recommendations, and guide you to your next good step.

Now it's time for your first step. This is where your longevity journey becomes practical. You'll get to know the most important tools that will support you every day.

First, we'll define your Longevity Compass together. It shows you your direction and helps you see your personal goals more clearly.

After that, you'll meet Autopilot. It helps you bring good habits into your daily life. It reminds you of important things and makes it easier to stay on track every day.

And whenever you need me, the ORB is your direct path to me. One tap, and I'm there. Ask me for advice, an idea, motivation, a recommendation, or simply information.

Your first step connects everything: your Compass, your profile, your Daily Diary, your Autopilot, the ORB, and the MAXINA community. That's how an idea becomes a real journey.

The journey is the destination. Enjoy your journey every day. See your improvement. Feel your success. Every small step brings you closer to a life with more energy, more joy, and more clarity.

fields.short_description: You don't have to figure anything out – lean back and listen.

fields.vitana_voice_script:
I'm glad you're here. I'm Vitana, and this audiobook is made for you.

You might be wondering where to start right now. The good news: You don't have to figure anything out, set anything up, or make any decisions. You just have to listen.

In each episode, I'll tell you a bit about how MAXINA works and how the community can support you in living healthier and with more joy. The episodes are short. You can listen to them while taking a walk, while cooking, or in the evening on the sofa.

If you need a break, just press pause. If you want to know something in more detail, tap "Ask Vitana" and we'll talk about it. But that's completely optional.

For today, it's enough if you just keep listening. The next episode starts right away.

fields.short_description: How MAXINA fits into a completely normal day.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: An example day that shows how MAXINA accompanies you in everyday life.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You see that MAXINA fits into your life instead of changing it.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: When you want to imagine what MAXINA feels like.
fields.explanation_try_this: Think of a moment in your day when a little break would do you good.
fields.vitana_voice_script:
Imagine a completely normal day.

In the morning, you briefly ask me what's coming up today. I remind you of your appointment at ten and suggest you drink a big glass of water before breakfast. That takes one minute.

At midday, you see that a few people from the community are going for a walk together this evening. You don't have to join, but you know the option is there.

In the afternoon, you notice you're tired. You simply tell me, and I help you take a little break: a few calm breaths, or a quick walk to the window.

In the evening, you tell me in two sentences how your day was. I remember what matters to you so I can support you even better tomorrow.

That's what MAXINA looks like in everyday life: no obligations, just small, friendly moments that do you good.

fields.short_description: Who I am, what I can do for you, and what happens with your data.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Vitana, your personal companion – what she can do and how she handles your data.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You know what Vitana can help you with and that you decide what she remembers.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: When you want to know if you can trust Vitana.
fields.explanation_try_this: Ask Vitana sometime: "What do you know about me?"
fields.vitana_voice_script:
Let me tell you a bit about myself.

I'm Vitana, your personal companion in MAXINA. You can talk to me like you would with a good friend who knows a lot about health and about this app.

I can explain things to you, remind you of appointments, show you events near you, and take care of many things for you. You don't have to search through menus. Just tell me what you need.

So I can really help you, I remember what you tell me: for example, what matters to you or what goals you have. You always decide for yourself. You can ask me anytime what I know about you, and you can ask me to forget something.

I'm not a doctor and I don't replace medical advice. But I'm here, every day, and I help you take good care of yourself.

fields.short_description: The MAXINA community: people walking the same path.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The MAXINA community – like-minded people who support each other.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You know you'll find support without having to commit to anything.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: When you feel like connecting – or just want to read along.
fields.explanation_try_this: Take a relaxed look at the community sometime, just to read.
fields.vitana_voice_script:
Living healthy is easier when you don't have to do it alone.

That's why the MAXINA community exists. Here you'll meet people who want to bring more energy, more calm, and more joy into their lives. Some are just starting out, like you. Others have been here longer and are happy to share what has helped them.

You can simply read along without writing anything yourself. You can join events, online or near you. And if you like, you'll find people with similar interests, for example for walking or cooking together.

No one expects anything from you. You decide how much you share and how close you want to get to others.

Just remember one thing: Whenever you need support, someone is here for you. And me, always.

fields.display_label: What you can ignore for now
fields.short_description: You don't have to use everything at once – really.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Permission to use just three things at the start.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll stop feeling overwhelmed by everything the app can do.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Whenever the app feels like too much.
fields.explanation_try_this: Remember these three things: the audiobook, Vitana, your journey.
fields.vitana_voice_script:
Let me tell you something: You don't need to know everything that's here.

MAXINA has many areas. A marketplace, live rooms, statistics, settings, and quite a bit more. All of that is there for later, when you get curious. Today, you can safely ignore it.

To start, you only need three things: this audiobook, which explains everything to you at your own pace. The glowing button that lets you talk to me. And your journey, where you can see what's coming next.

If anything feels like too much, just tell me. I'll show you only what really matters right now.

Health doesn't come from doing everything at once – it comes from staying with it. And that works best when it feels easy.

fields.short_description: Why small habits achieve more than big resolutions.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Why small, regular steps are the heart of your journey.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll know that one episode and one small step a day is enough.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: When you're trying to take on too much at once.
fields.explanation_try_this: Think of one small step you'd like to try tomorrow.
fields.vitana_voice_script:
To close this prologue, I want to share with you how change really works.

Big resolutions often only last a few days. Small steps, on the other hand, you can take every day. One more glass of water. Ten minutes of fresh air. Going to bed half an hour earlier. On their own, they seem small. But when you repeat them week after week, they can make a real difference.

This audiobook is built the same way. One episode a day is plenty. You'll learn step by step what MAXINA offers you, and you only try what you feel like trying.

Next, your actual longevity journey begins. I'll show you how it works, and together we'll find your first small step.

Thank you for listening this far. Let's keep going.
